turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm getting my dad a new phone and I want to pick the right one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a simple phone with big buttons and a large screen, made for people who aren't techy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is the same brand he's using now, just the newer version, so everything feels familiar.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a cheap basic smartphone that mostly does calls, texts and photos.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Does he struggle with his current phone, or is it just old? If he's comfortable with it, get the newer version of the same one. If he struggles, the big screen phone could really help.
